items.title_en: Microsoft outage: company scrambles to fix global issue that took down Outlook and Teams
items.title_zh: 微軟系統大當機：公司緊急修復導致 Outlook 與 Teams 無法使用的全球性問題
items.summary_en: Microsoft had a big technical problem that affected many users around the world. Popular services like Outlook and Teams stopped working for a while. The company apologized and said they have fixed the issue.
items.summary_zh: 微軟發生了嚴重的技術問題，影響了全球許多用戶。Outlook 和 Teams 等熱門服務一度無法使用。公司已道歉並表示問題已經修復。
items.why_important_en: This shows how much we rely on technology for daily work and communication. When big systems fail, it causes problems for businesses and public services.
items.why_important_zh: 這顯示了我們在日常工作與溝通中對科技的依賴程度。當大型系統故障時，會對企業與公共服務造成困擾。

vocab.definition_en: A problem or a subject that people are talking about.
vocab.sentence_en: We need to discuss this issue at the next meeting.
vocab.sentence_zh: 我們需要在下次會議討論這個問題。

vocab.definition_en: A situation where something is stopped or prevented from continuing as usual.
vocab.sentence_en: The road construction caused a major disruption to traffic.
vocab.sentence_zh: 道路施工造成了嚴重的交通中斷。

items.title_en: Nationwide FAA ground stop: nearly 11,000 flights delayed or canceled at airports across the US
items.title_zh: 全美 FAA 停飛令：美國各地機場近 11,000 個航班延誤或取消
items.summary_en: The US aviation authority stopped all flights across the country due to a communication error. This caused thousands of flights to be delayed or canceled on Friday. Officials said there was no sign of a criminal attack.
items.summary_zh: 美國航空管理局因通訊錯誤暫停了全國所有航班。這導致週五有數千個航班延誤或取消。官員表示沒有跡象顯示這是犯罪攻擊。
items.why_important_en: Air travel is essential for the economy, and large-scale delays affect thousands of travelers and businesses.
items.why_important_zh: 航空旅行對經濟至關重要，大規模的延誤會影響數千名旅客與企業。

vocab.definition_en: To make something happen later than it was planned.
vocab.sentence_en: The heavy rain will delay our flight by two hours.
vocab.sentence_zh: 大雨會讓我們的航班延誤兩小時。

vocab.definition_en: To decide that a planned event will not happen.
vocab.sentence_en: Please call the hotel to cancel your room reservation.
vocab.sentence_zh: 請打電話給飯店取消你的訂房。

items.title_en: US Air Force responds to suspected drone activity at RAF Lakenheath
items.title_zh: 美國空軍回應 RAF Lakenheath 疑似無人機活動
items.summary_en: The US Air Force checked reports of unauthorized drones at an airbase in England. They confirmed that no people or equipment were harmed. The base remains safe.
items.summary_zh: 美國空軍調查了英國一處空軍基地出現未經授權無人機的報告。他們確認沒有人員或設備受到傷害。基地目前安全。
items.why_important_en: Security at military bases is very important to protect national safety and defense equipment.
items.why_important_zh: 軍事基地的安全對於保護國家安全與防禦設備至關重要。

vocab.definition_en: The state of doing things or being busy.
vocab.sentence_en: There is a lot of activity at the office today.
vocab.sentence_zh: 辦公室今天有很多活動。

vocab.definition_en: The set of necessary tools or machines for a particular purpose.
vocab.sentence_en: The gym has new equipment for all the members.
vocab.sentence_zh: 健身房有供所有會員使用的新器材。

items.title_en: Aide to fugitive Ukrainian ex-PM wounded in latest Moscow car bombing
items.title_zh: 烏克蘭前總理的助手在莫斯科汽車炸彈攻擊中受傷
items.summary_en: A former adviser to a Ukrainian politician was hurt in a car explosion in Moscow. The man now works as a journalist. This is the latest in a series of attacks.
items.summary_zh: 一位烏克蘭政治人物的前顧問在莫斯科的一場汽車爆炸中受傷。該男子目前擔任記者。這是近期一系列攻擊事件中的最新一起。
items.why_important_en: Targeted attacks on political figures can increase tensions between countries and affect regional stability.
items.why_important_zh: 針對政治人物的攻擊可能會加劇國家間的緊張局勢，並影響區域穩定。

vocab.definition_en: Injured by a weapon or in an accident.
vocab.sentence_en: The soldier was wounded during the training exercise.
vocab.sentence_zh: 士兵在訓練演習中受傷了。

vocab.definition_en: The most recent or newest thing.
vocab.sentence_en: Have you seen the latest report on our sales?
vocab.sentence_zh: 你看過我們最新的銷售報告了嗎？

items.title_en: At least 24 killed after bus collides with truck in north-east India
items.title_zh: 印度東北部巴士與卡車相撞，至少 24 人死亡
items.summary_en: A bus and a truck crashed in India, killing at least 24 people. Some of the victims were college students. Local officials are still working to identify everyone.
items.summary_zh: 印度發生巴士與卡車相撞事故，造成至少 24 人死亡。部分受害者是大學生。當地官員仍在確認所有人的身分。
items.why_important_en: Road accidents are a major cause of death, and this tragic event highlights the need for better road safety.
items.why_important_zh: 交通事故是死亡的主要原因之一，這起悲劇凸顯了改善道路安全的需求。

vocab.definition_en: To hit something with force while moving.
vocab.sentence_en: The two cars collided at the busy intersection.
vocab.sentence_zh: 兩輛車在繁忙的十字路口相撞了。

vocab.definition_en: To recognize someone or something and say who or what they are.
vocab.sentence_en: Can you identify the person in this photo?
vocab.sentence_zh: 你能認出這張照片裡的人是誰嗎？
